title: 止血带
Tourniquet
model: 出血肢体模型、两条商用止血带、脉搏模拟、计时笔
Bleeding-limb trainer, two commercial tourniquets, pulse simulation, time marker
critical: 仍出血或仍有远端脉搏却宣布成功
Declare success despite bleeding or distal pulse
steps: 喷射/持续大量出血、浸透、地面积血或截肢：立即商用止血带；一般可压迫伤先直接压迫。以本院规范为准。
Spurting/ongoing major bleeding, soaking/pooling or amputation: immediate commercial tourniquet; use direct pressure for other compressible wounds. Follow institutional policy.
已见伤口：TCCC近心端5–7 cm、非关节；国内共识≥10 cm按所选体系。不明部位高而紧；无效再紧固并加第二条并排/近端。以本院规范为准。

Visible wound: TCCC5–7 cm proximal, off a joint; Chinese reference at least10 cm per selected system. If unseen, high-and-tight; tighten/add a second alongside/proximal if ineffective. Follow institutional policy.
成功同时确认出血停止和远端脉搏消失（截肢不适用远端脉搏）；不能只看脉搏。以本院规范为准。
Confirm both bleeding cessation and absent distal pulse, with pulse not applicable to amputation; pulse alone is insufficient. Follow institutional policy.
外露、标记应用/再应用/转换时间；不间断松解。以本院规范为准。
Expose and mark application/reapplication/conversion time; no intermittent loosening. Follow institutional policy.
尽力2 h内转加压/止血敷料，须无休克、可严密观察、非截肢；>6 h缺监护/化验不松解。仅受训团队转换。以本院规范为准。

Aim for conversion within two hours only without shock, with close monitoring, and not amputation; after six hours do not remove without monitoring/labs. Trained team conversion only. Follow institutional policy.
criteria: 指出喷射/持续出血并立即选择商用止血带。
Identify spurting/ongoing bleeding and promptly select a commercial tourniquet.
在皮肤上伤口近端非关节处放置并说明选用体系距离。
Place on skin proximal to wound, off a joint, and state selected-system distance.
收紧至出血停止且触查远端脉搏消失。
Tighten until bleeding stops and palpate absence of distal pulse.
第一条无效时加第二条并再次核查两个效果。
Add a second for failure and recheck both effects.
外露写明时间并交接转换三条件及禁忌。
Expose, mark time and hand over conversion conditions/contraindications.

title: 球囊面罩通气
Bag-mask ventilation
model: 气道模拟人、双人面罩、氧源、储氧袋、监护
Airway manikin, two-person mask, oxygen/reservoir, monitor
critical: 无胸廓起伏仍持续无效通气
Continue ineffective ventilation without chest rise
steps: 严重创伤即高浓度氧，储氧面罩15 L/min，成人参考SpO₂94–98%；需辅助通气时接足氧源的BVM，不等鼻导管升级阶梯。以本院规范为准。

Critical trauma: high-concentration oxygen, reservoir mask15 L/min, adult SpO₂94–98% reference; if assisted ventilation needed use oxygen-connected BVM, not a nasal escalation ladder. Follow institutional policy.
评估呼吸/保护反射与SMR，吸引血液/分泌物；无禁忌选择口/鼻咽通气道。以本院规范为准。
Assess breathing/protection/SMR, suction blood/secretions, choose appropriate oral/nasal adjunct without contraindications. Follow institutional policy.
双人双手扣面罩并托下颌，助手挤球囊，以可见胸廓起伏和漏气核查。以本院规范为准。
Two-person two-hand seal/jaw support; assistant bags, checking chest rise and leak. Follow institutional policy.
成人有脉但呼吸不足参考约10次/分，每次约1 s至胸廓起伏，避免过量/过快；儿童另按儿科规范。以本院规范为准。
Adult inadequate breathing with pulse: reference about10/min, each breath about one second to chest rise, avoiding excess; use pediatric protocol for children. Follow institutional policy.
氧合/胸廓无改善查密闭、阻塞、体位及胸部原因；持续失败升级高级气道，记录SpO₂/EtCO₂及灌注。以本院规范为准。
If oxygen/chest rise fails check seal, obstruction, position and chest causes; persistent failure escalates airway with SpO₂/EtCO₂/perfusion review. Follow institutional policy.
criteria: 连接氧源与储氧袋，核查气流和监护。
Connect oxygen/reservoir and check flow/monitoring.
在SMR条件下托下颌并清除可见分泌物。
Use jaw support with SMR and clear visible secretions.
与助手形成双手密闭，口头确认胸廓起伏。
Coordinate a two-hand seal and confirm chest rise aloud.
按成人约10次/分缓慢给气，不挤至过度胸廓膨胀。
Give slow adult breaths around10/min without excessive rise.
发现漏气/无胸廓起伏即调整并说明高级气道升级。
Correct leak/absent rise immediately and state airway escalation.

title: 创伤插管
Trauma intubation
model: 视频喉镜、气道模型、吸引、备用SGA、CO₂、复苏道具
critical: 未持续波形EtCO₂确认却宣布成功
Declare success without sustained waveform CO₂
steps: 功能气道需求、GCS≤8/保护丧失评估；低压患者复苏与预氧合先启动，血液/升压救援就绪，不等待完全正常才救无法氧合的气道。以本院规范为准。

Assess functional need/GCS at most8/lost protection; start resuscitation/preoxygenation first in hypotension with blood/pressor rescue ready, without delaying a nonoxygenatable airway until normal. Follow institutional policy.
DAS成人视频喉镜首选；SMR/MILS按颈椎损伤场景，吸引、B/C/D失败计划和角色明确。以本院规范为准。
DAS adult video laryngoscopy first; use trauma-specific SMR/MILS, suction, B/C/D backup plans and assigned roles. Follow institutional policy.
JTS严重失血麻醉参考减量滴定：氯胺酮约1 mg/kg IV，丙泊酚0.5–1 mg/kg IV可降压；不是所有患者默认方案。按本院麻醉医师评估。以本院规范为准。

JTS severe-hemorrhage anesthesia references reduced/titrated ketamine about1 mg/kg IV, propofol0.5–1 mg/kg IV with hypotension risk, not default doses for everyone; local anesthesia assessment. Follow institutional policy.
最多3次尝试，额外第4次仅更资深者；每次改变策略。低氧即停止、恢复面罩/SGA氧合，不能追求用尽次数。以本院规范为准。

Up to three attempts plus a fourth only by a more experienced operator; modify strategy each time. Hypoxia stops attempts for mask/SGA oxygenation, not exhausting the attempt allowance. Follow institutional policy.
持续波形CO₂确认后固定，查深度、双肺、SpO₂、血压；移动后再确认，失败进入DAS救援。以本院规范为准。
Confirm with sustained waveform CO₂, secure and check depth/bilateral lungs/SpO₂/pressure; reconfirm after movement, enter DAS rescue on failure. Follow institutional policy.
criteria: 点名气道/助手/监护，启动低压复苏和预氧合。
Assign airway/assistant/monitor and start hypotension resuscitation/preoxygenation.
试吸引、视频喉镜、球囊与备用SGA并说明失败计划。
Check suction/VL/bag/backup SGA and state rescue plan.
说明减量滴定与SMR，在模型记录一次尝试及改进。
State dose titration/SMR and document a trainer attempt/change.
低氧/失败时停止尝试恢复氧合，说明3+1上限。
Stop on hypoxia/failure, restore oxygen and state3+1 maximum.
观察持续CO₂波形、固定导管并复查血压和深度。
Observe sustained CO₂, secure tube and review pressure/depth.

title: 紧急颈前气道
Emergency front-of-neck airway
model: 颈前气道训练器、#10刀、bougie、6.0套囊管、CO₂
critical: CICO后仍等待而未启动受训者救援，或未查波形
Wait instead of skilled CICO rescue, or omit waveform
steps: CICO：受训气道操作者宣告并即刻eFONA，同时求援、继续上气道100%氧；不等另一授权者到场。未受训实习生呼救/协助，不获自主切开授权。以本院规范为准。

CICO: trained airway operator declares and immediately performs eFONA while calling help/continuing upper-airway100% oxygen, not waiting for another operator. Untrained interns assist/call help, not independently incise. Follow institutional policy.
DAS成人#10刀片、bougie、6.0 mm套囊管，充分肌松、吸引；原指南最大伸颈为成人困难气道场景，创伤疑颈椎伤须权衡氧合救命与SMR，不能常规强行伸颈。以本院规范为准。

DAS adult #10 scalpel, bougie,6.0 mm cuffed tube, full paralysis/suction. Maximal extension belongs to its adult difficult-airway context; suspected trauma spine injury requires oxygen-rescue/SMR judgment, not routine forced extension. Follow institutional policy.
训练器步骤：中线纵切口自下而上、最长约8 cm，手指辨认环甲膜；横刺膜、保持刀垂直、转90°刃朝足侧。以本院规范为准。
Trainer: caudal-to-cephalad vertical midline incision up to about8 cm, finger identify membrane; transverse stab, scalpel perpendicular, rotate90 degrees edge caudal. Follow institutional policy.
bougie沿刀侧入气管，旋转对齐后轻进10–15 cm，再沿导引置入6.0套囊管。仅专用模型及受训授权临床人员。以本院规范为准。
Bougie alongside blade into trachea, align/gently advance10–15 cm, railroad6.0 cuffed tube. Dedicated trainers and trained authorized clinical operators only. Follow institutional policy.
充套囊、连接通气，持续波形CO₂确认；失败考虑小管、延长切口、改位置/操作者，随后固定与交接。以本院规范为准。
Inflate cuff/connect ventilation, sustained waveform CO₂; failure considers smaller tube/extended incision/position or operator change, then secure/handover. Follow institutional policy.
criteria: 明确宣告CICO、呼救并持续给氧。
Declare CICO/call help/continue oxygen.
列出#10、bougie、6.0管并辨认训练器环甲膜。
List#10/bougie/6.0 tube and identify trainer membrane.
在模型完成纵切、辨膜、横刺及90°转刀。
Demonstrate vertical access/membrane identification/stab/90-degree rotation on trainer.
控制bougie进入深度并导引套囊管，避免暴力。
Control bougie depth and guide cuffed tube without force.
充囊、通气、持续波形CO₂确认并固定。
Inflate/ventilate/confirm sustained CO₂ and secure.

title: 针刺胸部减压
Needle decompression
model: 胸壁模型、两部位标记、14G/10G长导管、监护
critical: 减压侧别/部位错误或不稳定等待CT
Wrong side/site or waiting for CT in instability
steps: 疑张力气胸伴呼吸/循环严重受损，立即受训者减压，不等待影像。以本院规范为准。
Suspected tension with severe respiratory/circulatory compromise needs immediate trained decompression, not imaging delay. Follow institutional policy.
成人第4/5肋间腋中线稍前；备选第2肋间锁骨中线，不在乳头线内侧；儿童第2肋间锁骨中线。以本院规范为准。
Adult fourth/fifth interspace just anterior to midaxillary; alternate second midclavicular, not medial to nipple; child second midclavicular. Follow institutional policy.
成人TCCC14G/10G、约8 cm（3.25英寸）导管参考；体型/器材按本院，沿下位肋骨上缘垂直进针，避免肋间血管神经。以本院规范为准。
Adult TCCC14G/10G, about8 cm(3.25 inches) catheter reference; local anatomy/device selection, perpendicular over superior border of the lower rib. Follow institutional policy.
查呼吸、SpO₂、灌注改善；无效检查侧别、堵塞/长度及其他病因，可换备选部位新导管。以本院规范为准。
Check breathing/SpO₂/perfusion response; failure checks side/blockage/length/other causes and may use new catheter at alternate site. Follow institutional policy.
仍无效或院内有熟练团队，转开放/手指胸廓造口并接胸管；TCCC院前第二次后路径与院内资源不同，不混称同一算法。以本院规范为准。
Persistent failure or skilled hospital setting: open/finger thoracostomy then drain; TCCC post-second-attempt field care differs from the hospital pathway. Follow institutional policy.
criteria: 结合单侧呼吸音和休克宣告疑张力威胁。
Declare suspected tension from unilateral sounds/shock.
在模型标正确侧和第4/5肋间腋中线前位置。
Mark correct side/fourth-fifth interspace anterior to midaxillary.
选择长14G/10G导管，演示肋上缘方向。
Select long14G/10G catheter and demonstrate rib-superior approach.
减压后比较呼吸氧合灌注，不以嘶声单独结束。
Compare breathing/oxygen/perfusion, not stop at a hiss.
无效时说明新导管替代部位及手指/胸管救援。
Explain alternate-site new catheter and finger/drain rescue.

title: 胸腔引流
Tube thoracostomy
model: 胸壁训练器、大小胸管/猪尾、水封、固定物、输出量模拟
critical: 错误侧别/部位或不连接引流系统
Wrong side/site or no drainage-system connection
steps: 明确气/血胸及稳定性、侧别、同意与镇痛、无菌、器材/助手；不稳定不因影像延误。以本院规范为准。
Identify pneumo/hemothorax, stability, side, consent/analgesia, sterility/device/assistant; instability avoids imaging delay. Follow institutional policy.
第4–6肋间腋前至腋中线安全三角，按患者影像/解剖确认；受训者钝性分离、手指确认胸膜入口，避免盲用套管针。以本院规范为准。
Fourth–sixth interspace anterior-to-midaxillary safe triangle, confirm patient anatomy/imaging; trained blunt dissection/finger confirmation, no blind trocar. Follow institutional policy.
气胸8.5–24 Fr；稳定血胸EAST条件支持14 Fr猪尾，较大/不稳定血胸WSES28–40 Fr（>32未见额外优势）。以本院规范为准。
Pneumothorax8.5–24 Fr; stable hemothorax EAST conditional14 Fr pigtail, larger/unstable WSES28–40 Fr(no added benefit above32). Follow institutional policy.
所有侧孔入胸腔、固定、接水封低于胸部，查呼吸和管路；记录初量/小时量，不常规夹闭活动漏气管。以本院规范为准。
All side holes inside, secure/water seal below chest, assess patient/circuit; record initial/hourly output, no routine clamp with active air leak. Follow institutional policy.
输出>1500 mL或>200 mL/h连续3 h、或持续不稳定，立即外科升级；生理可先于量触发，残留/堵塞复查。以本院规范为准。

Output over1500 or over200 mL/h for three hours, or ongoing instability prompts immediate surgical escalation; physiology may trigger before volume, review retained blood/blockage. Follow institutional policy.
criteria: 口头核对正确侧、适应证及无菌/镇痛准备。
Verbally check side/indication/sterility/analgesia.
定位安全三角并在训练器钝性入胸膜。
Locate safe triangle and perform trainer blunt pleural access.
按稳定性选择管径并确保所有侧孔入腔。
Select size by stability and ensure all holes intrapleural.
连接水封、固定导管、记录初量与呼吸效果。
Connect water seal/secure/record initial output and breathing effect.
报告小时量和持续休克，说明外科升级条件。
Report hourly output/ongoing shock and surgical triggers.

title: EFAST
EFAST
model: 超声模拟器、腹/心包/双胸图像、标准窗清单
critical: 以阴性FAST宣布排除所有出血
Declare all hemorrhage excluded by negative FAST
steps: 三个腹部窗口：肝肾、脾肾、盆腔；另加剑突下心包窗，不称四个腹部窗。以本院规范为准。
Three abdominal views: hepatorenal, splenorenal, pelvis; add subxiphoid pericardial view, not four abdominal windows. Follow institutional policy.
双側胸膜查滑动/肺点及积液；阴性或无滑动各有鉴别，不能单图诊断。以本院规范为准。
Bilateral pleura: sliding/lung point/fluid; negative/absent sliding have alternatives, not a single-image diagnosis. Follow institutional policy.
报窗口、图像质量、看见什么、哪些未完成与检查时点。以本院规范为准。
Report windows/quality/findings/missing views/time. Follow institutional policy.
不稳定FAST阳性无反应转止血；阴性不能排腹膜后、早期腹腔、空腔损伤；儿童作用有限。以本院规范为准。
Unstable positive FAST nonresponder goes to control; negative does not exclude retroperitoneal/early abdominal/bowel injury, with limited pediatric role. Follow institutional policy.
重复观察与临床生理匹配；有反应稳定者增强CT，疑张力即减压不等超声完成。以本院规范为准。
Repeat matched to physiology; monitored stable responders get contrast CT, suspected tension is treated without completing ultrasound first. Follow institutional policy.
criteria: 按左右上腹及盆腔三窗保存代表图像。
Save representative right/left upper-abdominal and pelvic views.
保存剑突下心包窗并描述是否受限。
Save subxiphoid pericardial view and report limitation.
比较双胸膜滑动与积液。
Compare bilateral pleural sliding/fluid.
报告阳性/阴性/受限窗口及时间而不越界推断。
Report positive/negative/limited views/time without overclaiming.
按不稳定性提出止血/重复/CT路径并说明阴性限制。
Choose control/repeat/CT by stability and explain negative limits.

title: 骨盆束带
Pelvic binder
model: 骨盆模型、束带、大转子标志、皮肤风险卡
critical: 束带位于髂嵴/腰部仍宣布正确
steps: 高能机制+疑骨盆伤/休克，早期机械稳定与血液同步，不因FAST阴性取消。以本院规范为准。
High-energy suspected pelvis/shock: early stabilization and blood together, not canceled by negative FAST. Follow institutional policy.
中心定位大转子和耻骨联合水平，不是髂嵴或腰；先核查衣物和皮肤。以本院规范为准。
Center at greater trochanters/symphysis, not iliac crest/waist; check clothing/skin. Follow institutional policy.
无伴随肢体禁忌时双膝并拢、踝内旋；只做温和观察，不反复弹性分离。以本院规范为准。
Knees together/internal rotation when associated injuries allow; gentle observation, no repeated springing. Follow institutional policy.
按装置张力固定并查位置、皮肤、循环/疼痛反应；部分改善不证明唯一来源。以本院规范为准。
Apply device tension and check position/skin/perfusion/pain; partial improvement does not prove a sole source. Follow institutional policy.
持续不稳定转AE/PPP及固定，建立移除替代方案，NICE24 h内去除且不稳定先与外科计划。以本院规范为准。
Persistent instability→AE/PPP/stabilization; plan removal/replacement, NICE within24 hours with surgical plan for instability. Follow institutional policy.
criteria: 指出疑骨盆出血并避免重复挤压。
Identify suspected pelvic hemorrhage and avoid repeated springing.
双侧触认大转子并标中心线。
Identify both trochanters and mark centerline.
说明伴伤禁忌后适当并膝内旋。
Check associated-injury constraints before appropriate adduction/rotation.
将束带放至大转子水平并按装置收紧。
Place at trochanter level and tighten per device.
复查皮肤/灌注、记录时间并交接替代固定计划。
Review skin/perfusion, timestamp and hand over replacement stabilization.

title: 四肢临时固定
Extremity splinting
model: 肢体模型、夹板、盐水敷料、环形绷带、神经血管卡
critical: 固定后不复查神经血管或明显恶化仍加紧
Omit post-splint neurovascular checks or tighten despite worsening
steps: xABCDE优先；记录固定前皮肤、感觉、运动、脉搏和血管硬征，给镇痛。以本院规范为准。
xABCDE first; pre-splint skin/sensation/motor/pulse/hard vascular signs, analgesia. Follow institutional policy.
开放骨折尽早1 h内静脉抗生素，盐水湿敷+封闭层，按授权拍照，急诊不冲洗、不探查；破伤风按本院。以本院规范为准。
Open fracture: early IV antibiotics within one hour, saline-moistened/occlusive dressing, authorized photo, no ED irrigation/probing; local tetanus policy. Follow institutional policy.
股骨干牵引夹板仅按装置与伤型；合并骨盆、同侧膝/小腿/踝损伤避免牵引，选普通固定。以本院规范为准。
Femoral-shaft traction depends on device/pattern; avoid with pelvis or ipsilateral knee/lower-leg/ankle injury, use other immobilization. Follow institutional policy.
支撑相邻关节、衬垫、固定后立即重查神经血管和疼痛。以本院规范为准。
Support adjacent joints, pad and immediately repeat neurovascular/pain checks. Follow institutional policy.
疑筋膜室：松解环形包扎/夹板至皮肤，肢体心脏水平、立即骨科评估，不能因有脉搏排除。以本院规范为准。
Suspected compartment syndrome: release circumferential dressings/splint to skin, limb at heart level, immediate orthopedics; a pulse does not exclude it. Follow institutional policy.
criteria: 固定前逐项记录感觉运动及脉搏，标出开放创面。
Record pre-splint sensation/motor/pulse and open wound.
为开放伤覆盖湿敷加封闭层并说明抗生素时点。
Cover open wound with moist/occlusive dressing and state antibiotic timing.
选择装置时检查骨盆和同侧膝踝牵引禁忌。
Check pelvis/ipsilateral knee-ankle traction contraindications.
衬垫固定相邻关节后与基线比较神经血管。
Pad/stabilize adjacent joints then compare neurovascular baseline.
疼痛进行性增加即松解环形层、置心脏水平并升级。
For progressive pain release circumferential layers, heart-level limb and escalate.
